name: MULPHA
recent: MULPHA 近期出现多项企业活动：子公司认购 USD7 million 的 SHK Latitude Alpha Fund，并拟出售 New Pegasus 的 33% 股权。执行主席 Lee Seng Huang 在 10 月多次申报减持股份。公司也发布了 2025 年报，并公布 2Q26 净利降至 RM170.8mil。
notable: 间接全资子公司 Mulpha Strategic Limited 于 2026 年 9 月 1 日认购 SHK Latitude Alpha Fund 的 USD7 million（约 RM28.28 million）。
间接全资子公司 View Link Global Limited 拟出售其在 New Pegasus Holdings Limited 的全部 33% 股权，预计净收益约 GBP33.8 million（约 RM190.3 million）。
执行主席 Lee Seng Huang 于 2026 年 10 月 15 日、22 日及 23 日申报减持合计 4,000,000 股普通股。
risks: 执行主席 Lee Seng Huang 在 10 月多次申报减持公司股份。

recent_en: MULPHA has seen several corporate activities recently: a subsidiary subscribed USD7 million in SHK Latitude Alpha Fund and proposed to dispose of its 33% stake in New Pegasus. Executive Chairman Lee Seng Huang filed multiple notices of share disposals in October. The company also released its 2025 annual report and reported 2Q26 net profit fell to RM170.8mil.
notable_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Mulpha Strategic Limited subscribed USD7 million (about RM28.28 million) in SHK Latitude Alpha Fund on 1 September 2026.

Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary View Link Global Limited proposed to dispose of its entire 33% equity interest in New Pegasus Holdings Limited, expecting net proceeds of about GBP33.8 million (about RM190.3 million).
Executive Chairman Lee Seng Huang reported disposals totaling 4,000,000 ordinary shares on 15, 22 and 23 October 2026.
risks_en: Executive Chairman Lee Seng Huang filed multiple notices of share disposals in October.
